MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable was the one item I would choose because I repeatedly buy practical connection accessories, and its extra length could help connect my TV equipment if the ports match.",
    "Connecting recommendations to my existing TV equipment made sense; the useful part was helping me connect what I already own."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks assume I want another way to watch TV, but I have no current need for one, and 4K capability is not a priority for my recorded 720p TV.",
    "The Echo devices and smart plug introduce voice control and automation needs that my mounts, charging cables, and power strips do not establish.",
    "The 16TB drive and six-pack of short Ethernet cables resemble things I buy only broadly: my memory cards serve smaller storage needs, and cable usefulness depends on the connection, length, and quantity I actually need.",
    "The earbuds do not connect to any current listening need in my history."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been stretched into wanting several other Amazon devices, although my tablet purchases included accessories with specific practical uses.",
    "Buying electronics accessories seems to have been treated as interest in electronics generally, without enough attention to what each accessory helps me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchase was a camera lens cap, and my repeated tripod purchases make camera accessories a more plausible current interest.",
    "I often buy items that support equipment I already own, such as a case, mount, reader, or charging cable; compatibility and a clear use matter more than a loose connection to that equipment.",
    "My storage purchases have been modest memory cards and related accessories, which does not establish a need for a very large external drive."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in useful connections but stretched my equipment purchases into unsupported interest in streaming, voice assistants, and much larger storage."
}
